title: 把道路接起来

source.prompt: TrackType: Music, VocalType: Instrumental. Original instrumental retro fantasy tactical RPG score. Clear memorable NEW melody, compact four-voice counterpoint, warm pulse-wave lead, rounded triangle bass, gentle acoustic chamber colors, restrained noise percussion, clean mobile-speaker mix. No vocals, no choir, no speech, no lyrics; no quotation or imitation of any existing melody. 130 BPM, coordinated tactical action on two fronts. Two original concise melodic ideas alternate over a shared bass pattern, clipped plucked chords and crisp light percussion. Intelligent determined momentum, compact phrase structure suited to a long strategy battle. Maintain steady repeating musical phrases throughout, no long introduction, no fade-out or final ending.
source.negative_prompt: vocals, singing, speech, lyrics, choir, crowd, harsh distortion, loud sound effects, abrupt stop

editing.method: four-bar-multiple pulse alignment and two-beat chroma/timbre/energy window search; cosine equal-gain overlap

rhythm.note: Algorithmic pulse estimate; musical beat/meter and perceived loop coherence require listening.
